page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7t.16xlarge is an x86_64 memory-optimized virtual server from the Enhanced instance family. Powered by the KVM hypervisor, this instance provides 64 dedicated vCPUs running on an Intel Xeon 8369B processor clocked at 2.7 GHz. The system includes 512 GB of physical memory, establishing an 8 GB per vCPU ratio suitable for workloads with demanding memory footprints.

Hardware allocation is focused purely on compute cores, volatile memory, and network throughput. The instance includes 32 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth to facilitate high data transfer rates across virtual networks. There are no bundled hardware accelerators or graphics processing units, and no integrated local storage volumes are attached, requiring all persistent storage to be provisioned via remote block storage services.

In terms of operational tradeoffs, the complete absence of local NVMe or SSD disks means storage throughput depends entirely on attached network volumes, making network link stability critical. Additionally, the instance provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating configured networking gateways or floating address assignments for external routing.

The ecs.r7t.16xlarge is tailored for large-scale enterprise services that require high memory capacity without dedicated graphics hardware. Typical deployment profiles include large in-memory databases, Redis caching clusters, big data processing frameworks, enterprise resource planning systems, and high-throughput data ingestion pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7t.16xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual server within the Enhanced family, built on the KVM hypervisor and the x86_64 architecture. It provides 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz, paired with 512 GB of system memory to maintain an 8 GB per core ratio. Network interfaces provide a 32 Gbps baseline bandwidth to support continuous node-to-node communication. The instance contains no integrated GPUs and zero local disk storage, requiring external network-attached volumes for persistent data retention. It also includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Given its high memory density and dedicated core configuration, the ecs.r7t.16xlarge is engineered for memory-heavy workloads including distributed in-memory databases, extensive caching layers, high-volume transactional processing, and memory-bound analytics clusters.
